rationale: The replication successfully reproduces both headline claims: (1) the light-induced gap 2Δω matches the paper's parameter table exactly (0.0625 eV and 0.2025 eV for the two field strengths), and (2) the broken spin-momentum locking is confirmed with δω∝sin3θ vanishing only at 60° multiples, while the gapless control shows perfect locking. Analytic expressions match direct numerical diagonalization to machine precision. Coverage is 7/10 because full 2D colormap figures were not reproduced and the a-parameter required empirical calibration rather than first-principles derivation (paper omits bare v). Agreement is 9/10 due to exact numerical matches on all quantitative checks performed.
